title: Beatrix and the Hymn
author: Zephyrine Pemberton
blurb: Xanthe Vasquez, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
